translations.en: The public research record associated with the supplied ORCID lists Kexin Xiang as the first author of “Organic Electrochemical Transistors for Neuromorphic Devices and Applications,” published in Advanced Materials in 2026. The review discusses organic electrochemical transistor platforms for neuromorphic devices and applications.
translations.zh: 与所提供 ORCID 关联的公开论文记录显示，Kexin Xiang 是《Organic Electrochemical Transistors for Neuromorphic Devices and Applications》的第一作者。该综述于 2026 年发表于 Advanced Materials，讨论有机电化学晶体管在神经形态器件及相关应用中的进展。
